acceptance.assertion: Actual original tracker fails with device wall +5min. Final production Core-duration helper and both ordinary targeted live-chime and persisted recovery admission accept valid calls with snapshot wall +/-5min. Late snapshots wait for a new Core generation without a wall-clock gate.
acceptance.scope: host production Foundation helper + native source

acceptance.assertion: Expired or unknown Core duration cannot admit a chime; accepted revisions and terminal call identities do not re-ring. A duplicate pending event does not renew the ten-second admission TTL; the queue is bounded to 128 identities and cannot issue cancellation.

Production callback identity rejects old Core/call/timer revisions; foreground identical generation/age remains blocked. Old Core results cannot admit pending chimes from a replacement Core, while a current result admits them. Foreign recovery candidates cannot replace the owned call anchor.
acceptance.scope: host production helper; UIKit dispatch inspected and cross-compiled

acceptance.assertion: Clean final r4 App compiles and links armv7 minimum iOS5.1 using the licensed local historical SDK, with zero unresolved non-system symbols. The retained clean r3 Core archive is reused only after exact Core/Web source hash equality; no post-iOS5 clock API is added.

historical_records_note: Non-frozen Core/app r2/r3 are development only. r3 frozen host/app results remain history; r4 host/app are final. The clean r3 frozen Core build is explicitly reused with matching source and archive hashes.
